# DeotPDF (덧PDF)

> Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) PDF annotation and note-taking app for Windows 10/11, written in C#/WPF on .NET 10. Users write on PDFs with a mouse and keyboard (pen, text-snapping highlighter, text boxes with Korean IME, shapes, images, sticky notes) and save a standard PDF whose annotations show in other viewers and stay editable in DeotPDF. It also ships `deot`, a JSON-output command-line tool that lets AI agents and scripts read PDF layout and add the same annotations; `deot mcp` exposes the same commands as an MCP server (stdio, limited to `--root` folders).

Korean name: 덧PDF. Korean description: 윈도우용 무료 PDF 필기·주석 프로그램. 강의 자료 PDF에 마우스로 필기, 글자에 맞는 형광펜, 한글 텍스트 상자, 페이지 편집, PDF 합치기, AI 에이전트용 명령줄 도구 `deot`.

Internal code name: PdfNotes (solution `PdfNotes.slnx`, namespaces, and the editing data stored in saved PDFs). The executables are `DeotPDF.exe` and `deot.exe`.
